title: SEC EDGAR All-In-One Input
description: Pass ANY of: ticker (AAPL), CIK (0000320193), accession URL, accession number (0000320193-25-000123), or free-text keyword query. The actor auto-detects intent and routes to the correct SEC endpoint. Set `mode` to override auto-detection.

query.title: Query (ticker, CIK, URL, accession, or keyword)
query.description: What to fetch. Accepts: stock ticker (e.g. 'AAPL', 'MSFT'), 10-digit CIK (e.g. '0000320193'), SEC accession number (e.g. '0000320193-25-000123'), full filing URL (e.g. 'https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/...'), or free-text keyword for full-text search (e.g. 'climate risk'). Defaults to 'AAPL'. NOT for non-US filings — SEC EDGAR covers US-registered issuers only.

mode.title: Mode (auto-detect by default)
mode.description: Override auto-detection. 'auto' = guess from query shape (recommended). 'company' = list filings for ticker/CIK. 'filing' = fetch one filing by accession/URL. 'search' = full-text keyword search across all filings. 'insider' = Form 3/4/5 insider trades for ticker/CIK. 'holdings' = 13F institutional positions for institution CIK. 'activist' = 13D/G beneficial-ownership stakes for company CIK. 'xbrl' = XBRL company facts (revenue, assets, EPS, etc.) for ticker/CIK. 'form-d' = Form D Reg D startup funding filings. 'recent' = latest global EDGAR feed.

formTypes.title: Filter by form types
formTypes.description: Filter results to specific SEC form types. Examples: ['10-K', '10-Q'] for annual + quarterly, ['8-K'] for current reports, ['4'] for Form 4 insider transactions. Leave empty for all forms. Applies to company, search, insider, recent modes. Ignored for other modes.

dateFrom.title: Filing date from (inclusive)
dateFrom.description: Lower-bound filing date in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g. '2024-01-01'). Filters to filings on or after this date. Leave empty for no lower bound. Applies to company, search, insider, holdings, recent modes.

dateTo.title: Filing date to (inclusive)
dateTo.description: Upper-bound filing date in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g. '2026-05-28'). Filters to filings on or before this date. Leave empty for no upper bound (defaults to today). Applies to company, search, insider, holdings, recent modes.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Cap on total dataset items returned across all modes. Each item is one filing, XBRL fact, insider trade, 13F position, search hit, or feed entry — charged $0.005 each. Range 1-10000. Defaults to 100.

includeFullText.title: Include full filing text
includeFullText.description: If true, fetches and includes the plain-text body of filings (HTML stripped) under `fullText` field. Increases run time and bandwidth substantially. Applies to filing and company modes when filings are fetched individually. Defaults to false.

enableAiSummary.title: AI-summarize filings
enableAiSummary.description: If true, generates a structured AI summary per filing (key points, risks, financial highlights) using Gemini 2.5 Flash. Charged $0.03 per summary IN ADDITION to the $0.005 result fee. Applies to filing and company modes. Defaults to false.

xbrlConcept.title: XBRL concept (us-gaap or dei tag)
xbrlConcept.description: Specific XBRL concept to fetch in xbrl mode (e.g. 'Revenues', 'Assets', 'NetIncomeLoss', 'EarningsPerShareBasic'). Leave empty to fetch all available concepts for the company. Applies to xbrl mode only. Uses us-gaap taxonomy by default.

x-vibeleads-execution-review: required; schema inspection is not execution permission
